_source: Jira project CARD (synthetic). Seeded via REST; original reporter and dates kept in fields.

issues.description: The 1400-COMPUTE-FEES paragraph in CBACT04C is an empty stub. Late and over-limit fees should be computed in the nightly interest run so statements show them on the same cycle.

comments.author: dev
comments.body: Parked. Need Finance to confirm fees belong in INTCALC at all; Billing may already assess them.

issues.summary: Transaction report totals off by one transaction
issues.description: TRANREPT (CBTRN03C) account totals and the grand total include the last transaction twice when the account changes on the final record.

comments.author: dev
comments.body: Reproduced. The ELSE branch adds the amount again. Low priority, finance reconciles from TRANSACT not the report.

issues.summary: Round interest normally instead of truncating
issues.description: Customers see interest a cent lower than our web calculator. INTCALC truncates; we should round half-up like everything else.

comments.author: maria
comments.body: Do not change without checking the interest policy page first. There is a reason it truncates.

issues.summary: INCIDENT: duplicate DALYTRAN record crashed POSTTRAN
issues.description: Nightly POSTTRAN abended on a duplicate transaction id from the card network feed. Interest ran late.

comments.author: leo
comments.body: Root cause: upstream feed resent a file. Upstream now dedupes.

comments.author: dev
comments.body: Keeping the abend on duplicate ids on purpose: it is the safety stop that kept us from double posting. Resolution: upstream fix only.

issues.summary: Duplicate TRAN-ID seen in production from COTRN02
issues.description: Two clerks added transactions at the same second and one got DUPREC. Volume is higher since the branch rollout.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: Known race from the max+1 approach. Was fine at 2020 volume.

issues.summary: PCI: card balance data in job SYSOUT
issues.description: Audit sample found account balance records printed in batch job output. Remove or mask.
New printer vendor needs a longer form. TRANREPT and the statement jobs (CBSTM03A) were checked; only page length changes.
VPN down 40 minutes. INTCALC and POSTTRAN unaffected (mainframe-side scheduling).

issues.summary: Add dark mode to the CardDemo screens
issues.description: Low priority UI request. COTRN02C and COACTUPC maps would need new attributes.
Topics: mainframe modernization, INTCALC ownership after Dana left, hiring.
